name: Viktor Kunčak
lab: Lab for Automated Reasoning and Analysis (LARA)
one_sentence_summary: Viktor Kunčak leads EPFL's LARA lab, advancing formal verification (Stainless for Scala), AI-driven Lean 4 autoformalization (LeanFlow, LeanFlow Web), and neural theorem proving — now extending into learned GPU-accelerated proof evaluators and a browser-based Lean proof environment.
matrix_summary: LARA has two notable new developments since September 2026: (1) a NeurIPS 2026 workshop paper on GPU-accelerated neural Lean proof evaluators trained on 4.84M programs, achieving 4.2× throughput and a ~31% GRPO training speedup; and (2) the launch of **LeanFlow Web**, a browser-based Lean 4 proof environment with live feedback and an AI assistant (Lemex), now in EPFL early access. Stainless v0.10.3 also shipped and star counts continue to grow.
